title: Empiria: A Composable, Browser-Based Environment for Simulation-Based Statistics Education
description: Empiria is a free, open-source, browser-based environment for simulation-based statistics education. It represents the inferential workflow as a composable dataflow graph: small modules ("nodes") are wired together with cables, a global clock advances the computation, and every intermediate quantity updates in real time — optionally beside the live mathematical formula each node computes. Numerical routines use exact recipes verified against R. (Distinct from the VCV-Rack synthesizer plugin formerly hosted under this repository name, now released separately as Stochast.)
